basic_info.description: Located in the desirable Mission Terrace neighborhood, this Marina-style barrel front home offers a great opportunity for the new owner to transform the home according to their unique vision. This home is located a few blocks from Balboa Park, freeway access, and a nearby Bart station.    As you enter the home, you are welcomed into the formal living room which looks out onto the street and has a charming wood-burning fireplace. The formal dining room is ideal for entertaining and has an elegant built-in wooden hutch. The spacious kitchen features a breakfast nook for casual meals. The two bedrooms are separated by one full bathroom.    There is an interior staircase that leads down to the one car garage, laundry area, a bonus room and plenty of storage. The property also includes a large garden that is ready for customization.
